===Runesmith's Law===
This magic item is part of [[Wintermark_economic_interests#Runesmith.27s_Law|Runesmith's Law]] rather than Imperial Lore. Any Wintermark character with the [[Crafting skills#Artisan|artisan]] skill can learn to make this item. Before they are able to do so they must swear a powerful ''geas'', and if they later leave the nation they lose the ability to make this item.
